definitions.duplicate_search: duplicate normalized search call body in a transcript
definitions.at_limit_vs_overflow: at_limit reaches 32768; overflow is separately logged after truncation

paired_analysis.score_semantics: step-100 validation environment reward after question/family aggregation; not paper Pass@1 and not proof that every saved branch transcript has a semantically correct finish
paired_analysis.representative_trajectory: prefer finish_accepted rows, then shortest response-token trajectory

detailed_case_diagnostics.scope: 8 cases x 3 representative step-100 validation trajectories; 24 full transcripts
detailed_case_diagnostics.event_units: reasoning + tool action + following observation; k is an event index, not a token index
detailed_case_diagnostics.gold_terms: casefolded unique alphanumeric content terms after the embedded stopword list
detailed_case_diagnostics.coverage_proxy: coverage=active unique gold terms / unique gold content terms; d=max(0.1,1-coverage); V=-log(d); delta=V_k-V_(k-1)
detailed_case_diagnostics.warning: coverage delta is an algebraic lexical proxy, not saved TRACE Eq.(7) likelihood credit; validation has no frozen-reference teacher-forced gold log-likelihood

validation_semantic_audit.mapping_check: all 929 rows mapped by full benchmark query and gts matched the same gold; substring-only search-result matches are not used
validation_semantic_audit.q254: Trace-only score=1 but finish answer Third Eye Blind / Out of the Vein versus gold The Bangles, Everything; grader_false_positive_needs_review
validation_semantic_audit.scope_limit: strict answer equality and gold-string presence are conservative evidence flags, not a replacement semantic judge

paper_alignment.trace_primary_control: FoldGRPO+Trace versus no-Trace; Trace-only is a project-specific zero-outcome-weight ablation
paper_alignment.trace_missing: per-turn ell_bar, d_k, V_k, delta_k, K-step credit correlation and ranking diagnostics
paper_alignment.context_folding_missing: paper-equivalent Pass@1, peak active context, main trajectory length and scope accuracy

public_reference_note: 29-case diagnostic: 9/29 success, 44.8% repeated-search cases, 65.5% main-fold cases; definition reference only, not a numeric baseline.
